title: Price impact miscalculation on partial closures
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When closing a trade via closeTradeMarketCallback, the contract allows a user to specify a percentage of the position to close. The callback correctly applies this percentage when calculating collateral to close, profit/loss, and trade value.  However, when calculating price impact through getDynamicTradePriceImpact, the function always uses the entire trade collateral, instead of the reduced collateralToClose.
